relationship_rules.description: Indicates that an entity is a plaintiff initiating legal action in a case.
Indicates that an entity is a defendant accused or sued in a case.
Indicates legal representation by an attorney or law firm.
Indicates judicial decision or resolution of a case, issue, or claim by a judge or court.
Indicates submission of a filing or document to a specific court or case file.
Indicates legal reference or citation of an authority, statute, case, or document.
Indicates judicial application of a statute, regulation, or legal doctrine.
Indicates legal interpretation or construction of a statute, contract clause, or doctrine.
Indicates higher court precedent setting aside or invalidating prior case authority.
Indicates judicial adherence to binding or persuasive precedent.
Indicates distinguishing facts or legal context of current matter from precedent.
Indicates that a claim, issue, or testimony is supported by evidence, testimony, or statutory authority.
Indicates that a claim, assertion, or testimony is contradicted by opposing evidence or testimony.
Indicates factual proof of an event or claim via specific exhibit or documentary evidence.
Indicates explicit textual mention of an entity inside a document, filing, or testimony.
Indicates employment or organizational affiliation.
Indicates formal employment relationship connecting individual to entity.
Indicates legal ownership, title, or controlling interest.
Indicates attorney or law firm representation of a party or matter.
Associates an event, hearing, or filing with a specific calendar date entity.
Associates an event, hearing, or document with a case or court proceeding context.
Temporal ordering indicating source event/date occurred prior to target event/date.
Temporal ordering indicating source event/date occurred after target event/date.
Associates a procedural filing, case, or task with a specific deadline entity or date.
